name: figma-fast
description: figmacli rebuilt: per-file locks, one Ego Space per file, CDP desktop transport first

scripts.test:repeat: for i in $(seq 1 20); do bun --bun vitest run --pool=threads --silent || exit 1; done
scripts.build:holder: cd holder && CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=darwin GOARCH=arm64 go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w" -o ../dist/figma-fast-holder-darwin-arm64 ./cmd/figma-fast-holder && CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w" -o ../dist/figma-fast-holder-linux-amd64 ./cmd/figma-fast-holder
scripts.test:holder: cd holder && go vet ./... && go test -race -count=20 ./...
